text: どうだい　よく　わかったかな？

structure.jp: よく　わかったかな？
structure.en: did you understand well, I wonder?

patterns.name: 〜かな
patterns.explanation: かな at the end means 'I wonder', a soft way of asking. わかったかな？ = 'did you get it, I wonder?'.

patterns.name: 〜だい
patterns.explanation: だい after a question word is a friendly, manly way of asking, in place of ですか. どうだい = 'how about it?'.
